turns.doctor_question: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?
turns.patient_response: I came in because I just feel restless all the time, like I got a motor running inside me. If I have to sit still—like at church, here at the clinic, or even just at home—I start feeling trapped, and I have to get up or do something.
